aurelm_emby.title: Emby
aurelm_emby.description: The head unit as a cast target for the Emby phone app: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then choose "BMW iDrive" in Emby's cast menu. The film plays on the centre screen while parked, its sound on the car's speakers; pause, seek and stop from the phone. Needs the Emby cast service.
aurelm_emby.author: custom

aurelm_tvh.title: TVH
aurelm_tvh.description: Tvheadend's TV channels on the centre screen: sign in once from the phone (QR code), then Watch, Channel + / -, or the channel list over the picture. The picture shows while parked, the sound plays on the car's speakers. The server transcodes (profiles mgu-hd, mgu-sd, mgu-low: H.264 deinterlaced, AAC) and the profile goes down by itself when the internet is slow. Needs the TVH service.
aurelm_tvh.author: custom
